item: V2 hero TEP (direct kill, uplift2 section 3)

definitions.dk: direct kill: removal at the first step with B X_n >= Exp(1) threshold (same law as per-step removal w.p. 1-exp(-B e_n)); 3 designs share the Brownian paths, independent thresholds
definitions.functionals: item 1 functionals with validation bandwidths h'_j = clip(0.3 sigma_j, 0.003, 0.05); valley cuts; jackknife over groups of 5000 walkers
definitions.smoothing_correction: delta_L = t*_h(quad_L) - t*_h'(quad_L) (exact); corrected peak = DK peak + delta_L estimates the design functional (h_j = 0.1 sigma_j)
definitions.quad_z: (DK_L - quad_L) / SE_L with quad_L the exact discrete law at dt_L (same functional)
definitions.tep: fb_v2_tep.richardson: R1 = 2Q(dt/4)-Q(dt/2), R2 = (8Q4-6Q2+Q1)/3; TE_L = |Q_L-R1|+2SE_L, TE_c = |R2-R1|+2SE(R1); peaks pass if |Q-T| <= max(0.01, TE), ratios/masses if |Q-target| <= TE
